details.description: Nomic Embed Text v1 is an open-weight text embedding model from Nomic AI, built on a long-context BERT-style encoder with an 8192-token input length. It converts text into dense vectors for semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, clustering, and classification, using task-specific prefixes such as `search_document` and `search_query`. Nomic reports it surpasses OpenAI's text-embedding-ada-002 and text-embedding-3-small on the MTEB benchmark, and releases the model weights, training code, and training data openly under Apache 2.0.
advantages: Scores 62.39 on the MTEB benchmark, ahead of OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small at 62.26, per Nomic AI's own comparison.
Supports an 8192-token input length, matching or exceeding OpenAI's ada-002/text-embedding-3-small context (Nomic AI).
Model weights, training code, and training data are released openly under Apache 2.0 (Nomic AI).
disadvantages: Requires a task-specific prefix (e.g. `search_document`, `search_query`) before embedding, rather than working prefix-free (Nomic AI).
Documented as an English-language model (Nomic AI).

notes: Only source found and opened was the Hugging Face model card; no separate nomic.ai blog page could be located to fetch. The card does not state embedding output dimensions, so that is left out rather than guessed. Facts list max_input_tokens 8192, matching the card.
